propositions.text: lru_results returns the list of results of the get operations, in the order the gets occur.
A get on a present key returns that key's current value.
A get on an absent key returns None (serialized as null).
A put inserts a new key or updates the value of an existing key.
When inserting a brand-new key would exceed capacity, the least-recently-used key is evicted first.
Both gets and puts count as a use that makes the key the most recently used.
The least-recently-used key is the one whose last get or put is furthest in the past.
Updating an existing key's value never triggers an eviction.
Put operations produce no entry in the returned list.
An operation is a list shaped as either ["put", key, value] or ["get", key].
An empty operations list returns an empty list.
